name: Banner Medical
description: Banner Medical is a strategic business unit of Banner Industries. Since 1961, Banner Industries has served the precision machining industry by providing the highest quality materials and value-added services that offer superior processing capability, reduced supply chain complexity, and risk mitigation. As an ISO 13485 certified supplier to the medical device industry, Banner Medical has implemented stringent quality standards and employs talented personnel who have thoroughly validated our equipment through the IQ, OQ, and PQ processes required by FDA protocol. Though few processors of medical grade material perform validation testing to this degree, we can confirm that our machining processes do not change the physical properties of the material, and assure you that our materials will meet your specifications every time. Our mission is to provide defect-free materials and components that allow our customers to manufacture the best products for the medical device industry.
